done_when: forge land <item> --note "<text>" passes the note to the round it starts, the same way forge work --note does, on a new repo and on an earlier-adopted repo; the coordinator guide says to queue several items by running forge land for each in the background, because Forge admits their rounds by machine capacity
why: A client coordinator wrote its own shell queues to run rounds one at a time, and parallel queues raced each other; forge land already builds, closes, runs fix rounds and merges with each round waiting for a machine place, but it takes no note for the first round, so coordinators chain forge work --note and forge land by hand (issue 968)
